scenarios.title: A ravenous creature enters with X counters and draws a card if X is 5 or more

setup.notes: Aberrant is {X}{1}{G}, 0/0 with ravenous and trample. Its other ability is inert here.

decisions: A casts Aberrant with X = 5, tapping seven Forests. It resolves.

variants.label: x_five
variants.expected: Aberrant enters with five +1/+1 counters and is a 5/5. Its ravenous trigger fires (X is 5) and A draws a card: hand Forest, library 1 card.

variants.label: x_four
variants.delta: A casts Aberrant with X = 4, tapping six Forests.
variants.expected: Aberrant enters with four +1/+1 counters and is a 4/4. The ravenous trigger does not fire (X is less than 5): A draws no card, hand is empty, library 2 cards.
